Smart Cities & GovTech

Energy Sector AI

AI-powered predictive maintenance, digital twins, and cloud operations for NNPCL and IOCs. The oil sector is moving to cloud.

Nigeria's $3.28B cloud market is growing at 25.98% annually. Microsoft, Google, and AWS are all investing. The infrastructure is being built. What's missing is the advisory layer. the independent, hyperscaler-grade strategic intelligence that ensures Nigeria doesn't just participate in the AI era, but leads it.

The window to establish market leadership is 18 to 24 months. Luminary Meridian was built for this exact moment.

text:
Cognis
AI Strategy & Advisory

AI Strategy & Advisory answers five practical questions: where can AI help, what is ready now, what should happen first, who will own it, and how will success be measured? You receive a clear plan that leaders can approve and delivery teams can follow.

GET STARTED
GET STARTED
WHAT YOU GET
What a Cognis AI Strategy engagement delivers

A defensible roadmap, production-first delivery, internal capability transfer, and governance built in from day one.

Readiness Assessment

We map your data, skills, tooling and organizational appetite against the AI use cases that will actually move your numbers.

Executable Roadmap

A prioritised, phase-by-phase roadmap ranking every candidate use case by value, feasibility and risk — specific to your business.

“Quod Tango Muto: what we touch, we change. Every engagement leaves you permanently more capable.”

Cognis Group
Nigeria
Production-First Delivery

Every engagement ships at least one workflow into real production. We measure success by deployment, not decks.

Governance From Day One

Policy frameworks, audit structures and model oversight aligned with EU AI Act, AU Continental AI Strategy and sector-specific requirements — built in, not bolted on.

PROCESS
How we deliver

Many AI plans begin with technology and only later ask which business problem it should solve. That creates expensive trials that never become part of everyday work.

We begin with your goals, processes, people, data and risks. We then identify the opportunities worth funding and turn them into a practical plan with clear owners, costs, controls and measures of success.

1
Check what is ready.

We review your data, systems, people and existing rules against the work you want to improve.

2
Choose the right opportunities.

We rank ideas by business value, cost, difficulty, speed and risk.

3
Agree how the work will run.

We define who funds, owns, approves and measures each AI project.

4
Build the roadmap.

You receive a phased plan with named owners, dependencies and decision points.

5
Prepare leaders to decide.

We provide a clear investment case, expected results and a plain view of the risks.

FIT
Who this is for, and what you can expect
Who this is for

This service is for boards and leadership teams that need to make confident AI decisions. It is especially useful when an earlier trial stalled, regulations affect the next step, a new leader needs an independent view, or a wider change programme depends on AI.

Outcomes you can expect
An AI strategy with agreed priorities, owners and investment ranges.
A 12–24 month plan based on what your organisation can realistically deliver.
Clear rules for approving, managing and reviewing AI.
A repeatable way to judge future AI investments without depending on us.

AI Strategy & Advisory answers five practical questions: where can AI help, what is ready now, what should happen first, who will own it, and how will success be measured? You receive a clear plan that leaders can approve and delivery teams can follow.

WHAT YOU GET
What a Cognis AI Strategy engagement delivers

A defensible roadmap, production-first delivery, internal capability transfer, and governance built in from day one.

Readiness Assessment

We map your data, skills, tooling and organizational appetite against the AI use cases that will actually move your numbers.

Executable Roadmap

Nigeria
Production-First Delivery

Every engagement ships at least one workflow into real production. We measure success by deployment, not decks.

Governance From Day One

Policy frameworks, audit structures and model oversight aligned with EU AI Act, AU Continental AI Strategy and sector-specific requirements — built in, not bolted on.

PROCESS
How we deliver

Many AI plans begin with technology and only later ask which business problem it should solve. That creates expensive trials that never become part of everyday work.

We begin with your goals, processes, people, data and risks. We then identify the opportunities worth funding and turn them into a practical plan with clear owners, costs, controls and measures of success.

1
Check what is ready.

We review your data, systems, people and existing rules against the work you want to improve.

2
Choose the right opportunities.

We rank ideas by business value, cost, difficulty, speed and risk.

3
Agree how the work will run.

We define who funds, owns, approves and measures each AI project.

4
Build the roadmap.

You receive a phased plan with named owners, dependencies and decision points.

5
Prepare leaders to decide.

We provide a clear investment case, expected results and a plain view of the risks.

FIT

Who this is for

This service is for boards and leadership teams that need to make confident AI decisions. It is especially useful when an earlier trial stalled, regulations affect the next step, a new leader needs an independent view, or a wider change programme depends on AI.

An AI strategy with agreed priorities, owners and investment ranges.
A 12–24 month plan based on what your organisation can realistically deliver.
